blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶處理製程（上）：概覽、包裝、清洗、去熱原、充填、封塞
blocks.en: Glass Vial Handling Process (Part A): Overview, Packaging, Washing, Depyrogenation, Filling and Stoppering

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解玻璃瓶從製造商到製藥公司的整體搬運流程，以及各轉移步驟的風險控制要點。
blocks.en: Understand the overall handling flow of glass vials from the manufacturer to the pharmaceutical company, and the key risk controls at each transfer step.

blocks.zh: 掌握包材配置（pack-out configuration）的設計原則，以及棧板穩定性對運輸品質的影響。
blocks.en: Master the design principles of the pack-out configuration and how pallet stability affects transport quality.

blocks.zh: 認識洗瓶機的主要機型與針頭撞擊（needle strike）風險，並了解相應的預防措施。
blocks.en: Recognize the main types of vial washers and the needle strike risk, and understand the corresponding preventive measures.

blocks.zh: 理解乾熱滅菌（dry heat sterilization）與去熱原（depyrogenation）如何提高玻璃表面摩擦係數（COF），以及後續磨損損傷的成因與管控。
blocks.en: Understand how dry heat sterilization and depyrogenation raise the coefficient of friction (COF) of the glass surface, and the causes and control of the abrasion damage that follows.

blocks.zh: 掌握充填站與封塞站的損傷模式，以及轉移設計（gripper、star wheel、filling needle）對產品品質的影響。
blocks.en: Master the damage modes at the filling and stoppering stations, and how transfer design (gripper, star wheel, filling needle) affects product quality.

blocks.zh: 5.0 Glass Vial Handling Process — 玻璃瓶處理製程概覽
blocks.en: 5.0 Glass Vial Handling Process - Overview

blocks.zh: 5.0 解說：製程概覽與轉移風險
blocks.en: 5.0 Commentary: Process Overview and Transfer Risks

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「搬運即風險」
blocks.en: Core Concept: "Handling Is Risk"

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶從玻璃製造商出廠，到製藥公司完成二次包裝出貨，整條鏈上每一次轉移（transfer）都是潛在損傷點。TR87 的核心訊息是：損傷往往不在充填當下，而是在上游某個不起眼的搬運環節累積的。
blocks.en: From the moment vials leave the glass manufacturer until the pharmaceutical company completes secondary packaging and shipment, every transfer along the chain is a potential point of damage. The key message of TR87 is: damage often does not occur at filling, but accumulates at some unremarkable handling step upstream.

blocks.zh: 類比：像在搬一箱雞蛋
blocks.en: Analogy: Moving a Carton of Eggs

blocks.zh: 你不會把雞蛋放在顛簸不平的手推車上快速推行，也不會讓雞蛋彼此用力擠壓。玻璃瓶的邏輯完全一樣——地板、輪子、作業員訓練，全都是風險因子。一顆有微裂紋的瓶，在充填加壓或凍乾熱脹冷縮時就是未來爆瓶的定時炸彈。
blocks.en: You would not push eggs quickly over a bumpy, uneven cart, nor let them press hard against each other. The logic for glass vials is exactly the same: floors, wheels and operator training are all risk factors. A vial with a micro-crack is a time bomb for future breakage when it is pressurized at filling or subjected to thermal expansion and contraction in lyophilization.

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備術語（首次出現）
blocks.en: Key Equipment Terms (first appearance)

blocks.zh: Back pressure（背壓）：推壓瓶群時，後方的瓶對前方瓶造成的壓力，過大易造成玻璃應力集中。
blocks.en: Back pressure: the pressure that vials at the rear exert on the vials ahead when a group of vials is pushed; excessive back pressure easily causes stress concentration in the glass.

blocks.zh: Dead plate（靜止轉移板）：兩段輸送帶之間的靜止承接平板，是玻璃瓶轉移的常見磨損點。
blocks.en: Dead plate: the stationary transfer plate between two conveyor sections; a common abrasion point during vial transfer.

blocks.zh: Star wheel（星輪）：間歇轉動的撥瓶輪，用於定位與間距控制，也是衝擊風險最高的元件之一。
blocks.en: Star wheel: an intermittently rotating vial-pickup wheel used for positioning and spacing control; one of the components with the highest impact risk.

blocks.zh: Screw feed（螺旋進料）：利用螺旋槽定間距的進料裝置，間距不當易夾傷瓶身。
blocks.en: Screw feed: an infeed device that sets vial spacing by means of a helical groove; improper spacing easily pinches the vial body.

blocks.zh: 製程流程圖解讀
blocks.en: Reading the Process Flow Diagram

blocks.zh: Figure 5.0-1 顯示的是一條典型製藥廠玻璃瓶處理流程，每個箭頭代表一次轉移，每次轉移都有手動或自動操作介入的機會。設備材質、速度、對位精度是這條線上最需要工程管控的三個維度。
blocks.en: Figure 5.0-1 shows a typical vial handling flow in a pharmaceutical plant. Each arrow represents a transfer, and each transfer is an opportunity for manual or automated operations to intervene. Equipment material, speed and positioning accuracy are the three dimensions on this line that need the most engineering control.

blocks.zh: 5.1 Packaging for Transport and Storage — 運輸與儲存包裝
blocks.en: 5.1 Packaging for Transport and Storage

blocks.zh: 5.1 解說：包裝設計的學問
blocks.en: 5.1 Commentary: The Science of Packaging Design

blocks.zh: Pack-out Configuration（包材配置）的兩種主要形式
blocks.en: Two Main Forms of Pack-out Configuration

blocks.zh: Shrink-wrapped module（熱縮膜模組）：瓶與瓶緊密接觸，依靠收縮薄膜固定整體；優點是空間利用率高，缺點是一旦熱縮膜鬆弛，玻璃間摩擦立即加劇。
blocks.en: Shrink-wrapped module: vials are in close contact and held together by shrink film; the advantage is high space utilization, the disadvantage is that once the shrink film loosens, glass-to-glass friction increases immediately.

blocks.zh: Tray with/without cell partitions（托盤式，含或不含隔間）：有隔間的設計能避免玻璃直接接觸；選擇取決於瓶型尺寸與設備進料格式是否匹配。
blocks.en: Tray with/without cell partitions: a design with partitions prevents direct glass contact; the choice depends on whether the vial size and the equipment feed format match.

blocks.zh: 類比：就像裝運精密儀器
blocks.en: Analogy: Shipping Precision Instruments

blocks.zh: 航運高級相機鏡頭時，廠商會指定發泡材質、固定位置、棧板高度。玻璃瓶雖然是消耗品，但一批幾十萬支瓶若在海運途中因棧板雙層堆疊而壓碎，損失的不只是玻璃，而是整批製程可信度。
blocks.en: When shipping a high-end camera lens, the manufacturer specifies the foam material, the fixing position and the pallet height. Vials may be consumables, but if hundreds of thousands of vials in one batch are crushed at sea because pallets were double-stacked, the loss is not just the glass but the credibility of the entire batch process.

blocks.zh: 棧板設計要點
blocks.en: Key Points of Pallet Design

blocks.zh: 貨物不可超出棧板邊緣（set-back from edge）
blocks.en: Load must not overhang the pallet edge (set-back from edge)

blocks.zh: 層間需有 slip sheet（防滑墊片）
blocks.en: A slip sheet is required between layers

blocks.zh: 需有角落保護條（corner protection）與束帶（straps）
blocks.en: Corner protection and straps are required

blocks.zh: 棧板總高度需符合倉儲與運輸限制
blocks.en: Total pallet height must comply with storage and transport limits

blocks.zh: 嚴禁雙層棧板堆疊（double-stacking），特別在運輸中
blocks.en: Double-stacking of pallets is strictly prohibited, especially during transport

blocks.zh: 實務操作：QA 稽查 Checklist
blocks.en: In Practice: QA Audit Checklist

blocks.zh: 向玻璃供應商索取時，應確認以下文件：
blocks.en: When requesting from the glass supplier, confirm the following documents:

blocks.zh: Pack-out specification（包材規格書），載明模組/托盤尺寸與排列方式
blocks.en: Pack-out specification, stating module/tray dimensions and arrangement

blocks.zh: 運輸測試報告（vibration / drop test），驗證包材足以承受實際運輸應力
blocks.en: Transport test report (vibration / drop test), verifying that the packaging can withstand actual transport stresses

blocks.zh: 棧板配置圖（pallet layout drawing），確認與倉儲設備兼容
blocks.en: Pallet layout drawing, confirming compatibility with storage equipment

blocks.zh: 5.2 Integrated Line with Multiple Transfer Points — 整合產線與多重轉移點
blocks.en: 5.2 Integrated Line with Multiple Transfer Points

blocks.zh: 5.2 解說：整合產線的風險管理
blocks.en: 5.2 Commentary: Risk Management of Integrated Lines

blocks.zh: 多供應商整合的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Multiple Suppliers

blocks.zh: 現實中，一條充填線的洗瓶機、去熱原隧道、充填機、凍乾機可能來自 3–4 家不同設備商。每個介面的：速度配合、高度差、材質相容性，都需要在設備資格確認（IQ/OQ/PQ）前做好風險評估。TR87 明確要求要在機器設計與產線整合期間就執行 risk assessment，而非等到 validation 才發現問題。
blocks.en: In reality, the washer, depyrogenation tunnel, filler and lyophilizer of one filling line may come from 3 to 4 different equipment suppliers. For each interface, speed matching, height differences and material compatibility must be risk-assessed before equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ). TR87 explicitly requires a risk assessment during machine design and line integration, rather than waiting until validation to discover problems.

blocks.zh: 最高風險轉移點：Screw → Star Wheel
blocks.en: Highest-Risk Transfer Point: Screw to Star Wheel

blocks.zh: 螺旋進料（infeed screw）將瓶子定間距送入，星輪（star wheel）則以間歇動作接收。兩者的時序（timing）若有誤差，瓶子在交接點被「夾到」，產生的衝擊力遠超過玻璃的容許應力。這是產線上碎瓶事故的首要來源。
blocks.en: The infeed screw feeds vials at a set spacing, while the star wheel receives them with an intermittent motion. If there is an error in the timing of the two, the vial is "pinched" at the handoff point and the resulting impact force far exceeds the allowable stress of the glass. This is the primary source of vial breakage incidents on the line.

blocks.zh: 修正方向：精密加工的尺寸更換零件（size-change parts）＋低背隙齒輪或離合器（low-backlash gearing/clutches）＋定期時序校正。
blocks.en: Corrective direction: precision-machined size-change parts + low-backlash gearing/clutches + periodic timing calibration.

blocks.zh: 類比：高速公路匝道合流
blocks.en: Analogy: Merging onto a Highway

blocks.zh: 汽車從匝道合流主幹道，若時機不對就會側撞。星輪接瓶的原理相同——速度差、角度差、時間差，三個變數同時出錯就碎瓶。
blocks.en: When a car merges from an on-ramp onto the main road at the wrong moment, it causes a side collision. The star wheel picking up vials works on the same principle: when speed difference, angle difference and timing difference all go wrong at once, vials break.

blocks.zh: Eject Bin（退瓶箱）重新投入的風險評估要素
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Elements for Re-introducing Vials from the Eject Bin

blocks.zh:
風險評估應涵蓋：
1. 落下高度（drop height）
2. 緩衝墊規格（cushion/padding）
3. 清空頻率（frequency of emptying）
4. 重新投入前的目視檢驗等級（inspection level）
5. 退瓶箱邊緣設計（rounded edges，避免銳邊二次割傷）
blocks.en:
The risk assessment should cover:
1. Drop height
2. Cushion/padding specification
3. Frequency of emptying
4. Inspection level before re-introduction
5. Eject bin edge design (rounded edges, to avoid secondary cuts from sharp edges)

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 Accumulators — 積瓶轉台
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Accumulators

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 解說：積瓶轉台的損傷機制
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Commentary: Damage Mechanisms of Accumulators

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要 Accumulator？
blocks.en: Why Is an Accumulator Needed?

blocks.zh: 充填線各段設備速度不一致（如去熱原隧道連續出瓶，但充填機可能因更換規格或故障而短暫停機），accumulator 在中間起緩衝作用。常見類型：
blocks.en: The equipment sections of a filling line run at different speeds (for example, the depyrogenation tunnel delivers vials continuously, but the filler may stop briefly for a format change or a fault), and the accumulator acts as a buffer in between. Common types:

blocks.zh: Rotary table（旋轉轉台）：最常見，瓶子在旋轉台上做圓周運動排隊
blocks.en: Rotary table: the most common; vials queue up moving in a circle on the rotating table

blocks.zh: Push / back pressure（推壓式）：靠後方持續推力保持前進，易產生過大背壓
blocks.en: Push / back pressure: relies on continuous thrust from behind to keep vials moving forward; prone to excessive back pressure

blocks.zh: Bi-flow（雙向流）：可雙向輸送，靈活度高
blocks.en: Bi-flow: can convey in both directions; highly flexible

blocks.zh: 最常被忽視的損傷：Circumferential Scuff Rings（周向磨損環）
blocks.en: The Most Overlooked Damage: Circumferential Scuff Rings

blocks.zh: 旋轉台上，瓶子與瓶子持續對轉，如果某支瓶被困在迴流（eddy）中無法前進，就會在同一個高度被反覆磨擦，形成環狀磨痕。
blocks.en: On a rotary table, vials continuously rotate against each other. If a vial is trapped in an eddy and cannot move forward, it is repeatedly rubbed at the same height, forming a ring-shaped scuff.

blocks.zh: 位置：肩部下方（below shoulder）與瓶踵上方（above heel）——恰好是玻璃應力最集中的兩個幾何突變區。
blocks.en: Location: below the shoulder and above the heel, which are exactly the two geometric transition zones where glass stress is most concentrated.

blocks.zh: 後果：雖然外觀看起來「不嚴重」，但這些微裂紋在凍乾或高壓滅菌的熱應力下可能成為裂紋起點，造成 container failure。
blocks.en: Consequence: although the damage looks "not serious", these micro-cracks can become crack initiation points under the thermal stress of lyophilization or autoclaving, causing container failure.

blocks.zh: 類比：砂紙打磨原理
blocks.en: Analogy: The Principle of Sanding

blocks.zh: 兩支玻璃瓶在旋轉台上相互研磨，與用砂紙打磨是同一個物理原理。去熱原後的玻璃更像「乾燥的砂岩」——失去水膜潤滑，COF 升高，同樣的力道造成的磨損深度倍增。
blocks.en: Two glass vials grinding against each other on a rotary table is the same physical principle as sanding with sandpaper. Glass after depyrogenation is more like "dry sandstone": without the lubricating water film, COF rises, and the same force causes abrasion that is twice as deep.

blocks.zh: 旋轉台設計的關鍵規則
blocks.en: Key Rules for Rotary Table Design

blocks.zh:
最佳實務規則：
  裝載量 ≤ 轉台容量 × 1/3

轉台高度：
  轉台面 < 送入 dead plate 高度
  高度差需小到不讓瓶子傾倒

線速管控：
  各段速度應盡量一致 → 減少積瓶需求
  線體停止 → 轉台也應立即停止
  轉台速度設定 → 盡量低，以減少容器動量
blocks.en:
Best practice rules:

  Loading ≤ table capacity × 1/3

Table height:
  Table surface < height of the infeed dead plate
  The height difference must be small enough not to topple vials

Line speed control:
  Keep the speed of all sections as consistent as possible → reduces the need for accumulation
  Line stops → the table should also stop immediately
  Table speed setting → as low as possible, to reduce container momentum

blocks.zh: 實務：旋轉台操作 Checklist
blocks.en: In Practice: Rotary Table Operation Checklist

blocks.zh: 確認導軌材質為非磨蝕性塑膠（非金屬）
blocks.en: Confirm that the guide rail material is non-abrasive plastic (non-metal)

blocks.zh: 確認轉台有流向控制裝置（防止 eddy 形成）
blocks.en: Confirm that the table has a flow control device (to prevent eddy formation)

blocks.zh: 設定最大積瓶量警報，不超過容量 1/3
blocks.en: Set a maximum accumulation alarm, not exceeding 1/3 of capacity

blocks.zh: 線體停止時，確認轉台連鎖停止（interlock）有效
blocks.en: When the line stops, confirm that the table interlock stop is effective

blocks.zh: 去熱原後的第一個旋轉台須特別監控，此時玻璃 COF 最高
blocks.en: Monitor the first rotary table after depyrogenation with special care, as glass COF is highest at this point

blocks.zh: 5.3 Vial Washing — 洗瓶
blocks.en: 5.3 Vial Washing

blocks.zh: 5.3 解說：洗瓶機的損傷風險
blocks.en: 5.3 Commentary: Damage Risks of Vial Washers

blocks.zh: 洗瓶的目的
blocks.en: The Purpose of Washing

blocks.zh: 注射劑包材的洗瓶目標是去除：細菌毒素（bacterial toxins）、化學污染物（chemical substances）、微粒（particulates）。這直接關係到最終藥品的安全性與 FDA/EMA 的合規要求。
blocks.en: The goal of washing injectable packaging components is to remove: bacterial toxins, chemical substances and particulates. This bears directly on the safety of the final drug product and on FDA/EMA compliance requirements.

blocks.zh: Needle Strike（針頭撞擊）——洗瓶最大風險
blocks.en: Needle Strike: The Biggest Risk in Washing

blocks.zh: 成因：使用 diving spray nozzle 時，針頭必須準確插入瓶口。若對位不良（misalignment），針頭會撞到瓶底、內壁或瓶口（finish），導致：
blocks.en: Cause: when a diving spray nozzle is used, the needle must be inserted accurately into the vial mouth. With misalignment, the needle strikes the vial bottom, the inner wall or the finish, resulting in:

blocks.zh: 針頭彎曲 → 後續批次持續 needle strike 直到被發現
blocks.en: A bent needle, causing continued needle strikes in subsequent batches until it is detected

blocks.zh: 玻璃碎片（glass chips）產生 → 不可見微粒污染
blocks.en: Glass chips, causing invisible particulate contamination

blocks.zh: 瓶口損傷 → 封塞密封性下降
blocks.en: Finish damage, reducing stopper seal integrity

blocks.zh: 預防：定期目視或自動檢查針頭直度；換規格時重新確認針頭深度與對位；新款洗瓶機可配置 needle strike alarm。
blocks.en: Prevention: periodic visual or automated checks of needle straightness; re-confirm needle depth and alignment at format change; newer washers can be fitted with a needle strike alarm.

blocks.zh: 倒置瓶與雙層瓶（Inverted / Double-stacked Vials）
blocks.en: Inverted / Double-stacked Vials

blocks.zh: 在 bucket 式洗瓶機中，若有倒置或兩支瓶卡在同一 bucket，針頭撞擊的風險劇增，且因倒置瓶阻擋噴水，清洗效果也大打折扣。自動偵測剔除（automated detection and eject）系統是最佳解，無此功能的設備需建立手動程序。
blocks.en: In a bucket-type washer, if a vial is inverted or two vials are stuck in the same bucket, the risk of needle strike rises sharply, and because an inverted vial blocks the spray, cleaning effectiveness is also greatly reduced. An automated detection and eject system is the best solution; equipment without this function needs a manual procedure.

blocks.zh: 類比：注射針對準血管
blocks.en: Analogy: Aiming an Injection Needle at a Vein

blocks.zh: 醫護人員打針時若針頭未對準，會造成血管壁損傷。洗瓶機的洗針（washing needle）也是同樣道理——對位精度決定了是「乾淨清洗」還是「製造新的微粒污染」。
blocks.en: When a nurse gives an injection and the needle is not aligned, it damages the vessel wall. The same applies to the washing needle of a vial washer: alignment accuracy determines whether you get "clean washing" or "new particulate contamination".

blocks.zh: 實務：洗瓶機 PM 要點
blocks.en: In Practice: Key Points for Washer PM

blocks.zh: 換規格前：確認 needle depth、centering 設定值已調整
blocks.en: Before a format change: confirm that the needle depth and centering settings have been adjusted

blocks.zh: 定期：目視 100% 針頭直度檢查（建議每批次換規格後）
blocks.en: Periodically: 100% visual check of needle straightness (recommended after each batch format change)

blocks.zh: 旋轉式洗瓶機：確認水壓設定不超出 gripper 夾持力
blocks.en: Rotary washer: confirm that the water pressure setting does not exceed the gripper clamping force

blocks.zh: 批次洗瓶機：loading plate 與托盤規格需一一對應，建立文件管控
blocks.en: Batch washer: the loading plate and tray specification must correspond one to one, with documented control

blocks.zh: 5.4 Dry Heat Sterilization and Depyrogenation — 乾熱滅菌與去熱原
blocks.en: 5.4 Dry Heat Sterilization and Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 5.4 解說：去熱原後玻璃的脆弱性
blocks.en: 5.4 Commentary: Fragility of Glass After Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 乾熱滅菌 vs. 去熱原：溫度與時間比較
blocks.en: Dry Heat Sterilization vs. Depyrogenation: Comparison of Temperature and Time

blocks.zh:
乾熱滅菌（Dry Heat Sterilization）：
  溫度：≥ 160 °C
  時間：最長 2 小時
  目的：殺滅微生物（達 SAL 10⁻⁶）

去熱原（Depyrogenation）：
  溫度：約 325 °C
  時間：至少 30 分鐘
  目的：使熱原（pyrogens/endotoxins）降解
  法規依據：PDA Technical Report No. 3

關鍵記憶：
  去熱原溫度 >> 滅菌溫度
  → 對玻璃表面的影響更大
blocks.en:
Dry heat sterilization:
  Temperature: ≥ 160 °C
  Time: up to 2 hours
  Purpose: kill microorganisms (to SAL 10⁻⁶)

Depyrogenation:
  Temperature: approx. 325 °C
  Time: at least 30 minutes
  Purpose: degrade pyrogens/endotoxins
  Regulatory basis: PDA Technical Report No. 3

Key point to remember:
  Depyrogenation temperature >> sterilization temperature
  → greater effect on the glass surface

blocks.zh: COF（摩擦係數）升高的後果
blocks.en: Consequences of Increased COF

blocks.zh: 去熱原過程中，玻璃表面的「保護水膜（water skin）」被蒸發殆盡。這層水膜是天然潤滑劑，失去它之後：
blocks.en: During depyrogenation, the "protective water skin" on the glass surface is completely evaporated. This water film is a natural lubricant, and once it is lost:

blocks.zh: 玻璃表面 COF 顯著上升
blocks.en: Glass surface COF rises significantly

blocks.zh: 任何玻璃對玻璃、玻璃對金屬的接觸，磨損效果倍增
blocks.en: Any glass-to-glass or glass-to-metal contact causes abrasion that is multiplied

blocks.zh: 高溫時間越長，COF 升高幅度越大
blocks.en: The longer the time at high temperature, the greater the rise in COF

blocks.zh: Stuck marks（黏結垂直痕）：高溫下兩支接觸的玻璃瓶可能發生表面黏合（bonding），分開時留下垂直條痕，成為下游破瓶的應力集中點（stress concentrator）。
blocks.en: Stuck marks: at high temperature, two vials in contact may bond at the surface; when separated they leave vertical streaks, which become stress concentrators and sites of downstream vial breakage.

blocks.zh: 類比：剛出爐的陶瓷
blocks.en: Analogy: Ceramics Fresh from the Kiln

blocks.zh: 陶瓷器從窯中取出時表面乾燥、脆性最高，此時若相互碰撞，比常溫下更容易崩缺。去熱原後的玻璃瓶類似這個狀態——它在結構上完整，但表面保護層已不在，任何機械摩擦都留下傷痕。
blocks.en: When a ceramic piece is taken out of the kiln, its surface is dry and its brittleness is at its highest; if pieces knock into each other at this point, they chip more easily than at room temperature. Vials after depyrogenation are in a similar state: structurally intact, but with the surface protective layer gone, so any mechanical friction leaves a mark.

blocks.zh: 連續隧道式的三段溫區
blocks.en: Three Temperature Zones of a Continuous Tunnel

blocks.zh: 預熱區（Preheat zone）：避免玻璃因急遽升溫產生熱應力
blocks.en: Preheat zone: avoids thermal stress in the glass from rapid heating

blocks.zh: 熱區（Hot zone）：達成滅菌/去熱原的有效暴露時間與溫度
blocks.en: Hot zone: achieves the effective exposure time and temperature for sterilization/depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 冷卻區（Cooling zone）：緩慢降溫，避免玻璃因溫差破裂，並確保進入無菌區前已降至安全溫度
blocks.en: Cooling zone: cools slowly to avoid glass breakage from temperature difference, and ensures vials have fallen to a safe temperature before entering the aseptic area

blocks.zh: 「Pull mode」輸送帶設計：帶速略快於洗瓶機出瓶速，使瓶間保留 ~1 mm 間隙，避免背壓堆積。
blocks.en: "Pull mode" conveyor design: the belt speed is slightly faster than the washer output speed, leaving a gap of ~1 mm between vials and avoiding back pressure buildup.

blocks.zh: 5.4.2 操作注意事項彙整
blocks.en: 5.4.2 Summary of Operating Precautions

blocks.zh: 進隧道前瓶子必須完全乾燥——殘留水分在高溫下侵蝕玻璃內表面（etching/corrosion）
blocks.en: Vials must be completely dry before entering the tunnel; residual moisture attacks the inner glass surface at high temperature (etching/corrosion)

blocks.zh: 下游停線時必須連鎖停止進料（interlock），但隧道內已進入的瓶應繼續完成 validated cycle
blocks.en: When the downstream line stops, the infeed must be stopped by interlock, but vials already inside the tunnel should continue to complete the validated cycle

blocks.zh: 設置觀察窗（viewing windows）監控隧道內積瓶、倒瓶狀況
blocks.en: Install viewing windows to monitor vial accumulation and fallen vials inside the tunnel

blocks.zh: 不建議超出已驗證的去熱原時間，雖然玻璃結構不直接受影響，但水膜持續缺失時間越長越不利
blocks.en: Exceeding the validated depyrogenation time is not recommended; although the glass structure is not directly affected, the longer the water film stays absent, the worse it is

blocks.zh: 批次式去熱原烤箱（5.4.3）
blocks.en: Batch Depyrogenation Oven (5.4.3)

blocks.zh: 適用於小批量或研發階段。關鍵點：
blocks.en: Suitable for small batches or the development stage. Key points:

blocks.zh: 出烤箱後必須在 Grade A（ISO 5） 單向流下卸載，維持無菌條件
blocks.en: After leaving the oven, unloading must take place under Grade A (ISO 5) unidirectional flow to maintain aseptic conditions

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼托盤中的玻璃瓶無水膜保護，搬運時需盡量減少晃動以防磨損或破裂
blocks.en: Vials in stainless steel trays have no water film protection; during handling, minimize shaking to prevent abrasion or breakage

blocks.zh: 批次式的風險：相較連續隧道，出爐後需要更多人工轉移操作，暴露在非受控環境的機率更高
blocks.en: Risk of batch mode: compared with a continuous tunnel, more manual transfer operations are needed after the oven, and the chance of exposure to an uncontrolled environment is higher

blocks.zh: 實務：去熱原後的特別管控 SOP 建議
blocks.en: In Practice: Recommended SOP Controls After Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 去熱原後第一個旋轉台：轉速降至最低（low speed setting）
blocks.en: First rotary table after depyrogenation: reduce speed to the minimum (low speed setting)

blocks.zh: 所有導軌材質確認為非磨蝕塑膠，禁用金屬導軌
blocks.en: Confirm that all guide rail material is non-abrasive plastic; metal guide rails are prohibited

blocks.zh: 隧道出口至充填機之間的 dead plate 高度差不超過 1 mm
blocks.en: The height difference of the dead plate between the tunnel outlet and the filler must not exceed 1 mm

blocks.zh: 批次烤箱出爐：由受訓人員在 Grade A 罩下操作，避免敲碰托盤
blocks.en: Batch oven unloading: performed by trained personnel under a Grade A hood, avoiding knocks to the trays

blocks.zh: 5.5 Vial Filling — 充填
blocks.en: 5.5 Vial Filling

blocks.zh: 5.5 解說：充填站的損傷模式
blocks.en: 5.5 Commentary: Damage Modes at the Filling Station

blocks.zh: 充填針頭撞擊（Needle Strike）——充填站版本
blocks.en: Filling Needle Strike: The Filling Station Version

blocks.zh: 與洗瓶機的 needle strike 類似，但充填站的版本有一個特殊危險：瓶口（lip region）的損傷被封塞和鋁蓋遮蓋，目視檢查幾乎不可能發現。
blocks.en: Similar to needle strike in the washer, but the filling station version has a special danger: damage to the lip region of the vial is masked by the stopper and aluminum seal, making it nearly impossible to detect by visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 這代表一個已有瓶口微裂紋的藥瓶，可能順利通過出廠 AQL，直到消費者開蓋時才破裂——安全風險極高。
blocks.en: This means a vial that already has a micro-crack at the lip may pass the release AQL smoothly and only break when the consumer opens the cap, which is a very high safety risk.

blocks.zh: 特別風險：Offset finish（偏心瓶口）——瓶口幾何偏差的瓶子，更容易導致充填針偏斜。
blocks.en: Special risk: Offset finish. Vials with geometric deviation of the finish are more likely to deflect the filling needle.

blocks.zh: 類比：塑膠針頭的「犧牲設計」
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Sacrificial Design" of a Plastic Needle

blocks.zh: 一次性塑膠充填針（disposable plastic needle）的原理是工程設計的「安全保險絲」概念：寧可針頭自己彎折（便於偵測），也不要玻璃瓶受到損傷。金屬針頭則剛好相反——金屬夠硬，撞到瓶時是玻璃先碎。
blocks.en: The principle of the disposable plastic filling needle is the engineering "safety fuse" concept: it is better for the needle itself to bend (making it easy to detect) than for the glass vial to be damaged. A metal needle is the opposite: it is hard enough that when it hits a vial, the glass breaks first.

blocks.zh: 稱重取樣時的損傷風險
blocks.en: Damage Risk During Weight Sampling

blocks.zh: 充填後定期取樣稱重（IPC weight check）時，若搬運方式不當（如直接夾瓶身金屬夾），很容易在此步驟造成損傷。建議：
blocks.en: When filled vials are periodically sampled for weighing (IPC weight check), improper handling (such as gripping the vial body with a metal clamp) easily causes damage at this step. Recommendations:

blocks.zh: 使用 vacuum-assisted gripper 真空吸附取瓶
blocks.en: Use a vacuum-assisted gripper to pick up vials by vacuum suction

blocks.zh: 確保瓶子已清潔，避免微粒堵塞真空吸附孔
blocks.en: Ensure vials are clean so that particulates do not block the vacuum suction holes

blocks.zh: 建立標準化稱重取樣 SOP，納入人員培訓
blocks.en: Establish a standardized weight-sampling SOP and include it in personnel training

blocks.zh: 實務：充填線材質替換建議
blocks.en: In Practice: Recommendations for Replacing Filling Line Materials

blocks.zh: 導軌全線改用非磨蝕性塑膠（替換金屬件）
blocks.en: Change the guide rails along the whole line to non-abrasive plastic (replace metal parts)

blocks.zh: gripper 改為塑膠材質，確認與瓶頸尺寸相容
blocks.en: Change grippers to plastic material, and confirm compatibility with the vial neck dimensions

blocks.zh: 評估採用一次性塑膠充填針（減少 needle strike 破玻璃的風險）
blocks.en: Evaluate the use of disposable plastic filling needles (to reduce the risk of glass breakage from needle strike)

blocks.zh: 每班次定期目視檢查充填針對位與直度（建議記錄於批次紀錄）
blocks.en: Visually check filling needle alignment and straightness periodically each shift (recommended to be recorded in the batch record)

blocks.zh: 5.6 Stopper Placement — 封塞
blocks.en: 5.6 Stopper Placement

blocks.zh: 5.6 解說：封塞的品質意義
blocks.en: 5.6 Commentary: The Quality Significance of Stoppering

blocks.zh: 封塞站：損傷的「揭露點」而非「製造點」
blocks.en: The Stoppering Station: A Point Where Damage Is "Revealed", Not "Created"

blocks.zh: TR87 的重要結論：封塞過程本身無玻璃對玻璃接觸，玻璃損傷風險極低。但若在此站出現破瓶，幾乎可確定是上游某個步驟已累積損傷（最可能是 star wheel 交接點、旋轉台磨損、或充填針撞擊）。
blocks.en: An important conclusion of TR87: the stoppering process itself involves no glass-to-glass contact, so the risk of glass damage is extremely low. If a vial breaks at this station, it is almost certain that damage has accumulated at some upstream step (most likely the star wheel handoff, rotary table abrasion or filling needle strike).

blocks.zh: 因此，若在封塞站觀察到破瓶或碎玻璃：
blocks.en: Therefore, if broken vials or glass fragments are observed at the stoppering station:

blocks.zh: 應立即啟動root cause investigation，往上游溯源
blocks.en: A root cause investigation should be started immediately, tracing back upstream

blocks.zh: 評估同批次已封塞的瓶子是否有潛在隱性損傷
blocks.en: Evaluate whether vials already stoppered in the same batch may have latent hidden damage

blocks.zh: 重新審視去熱原後的旋轉台操作條件
blocks.en: Re-examine the operating conditions of the rotary table after depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 類比：最後一根稻草
blocks.en: Analogy: The Last Straw

blocks.zh: 一塊石板若有裂縫，輕輕一壓就斷了——但是你不會認為「是那個輕輕一壓的力量太大」，而是要追問「裂縫從何而來」。封塞站破瓶的邏輯相同，不要只修封塞機，要找那個讓玻璃先有裂縫的上游步驟。
blocks.en: If a stone slab has a crack, a light press will break it; but you would not conclude that "the light press was too strong", you would ask "where did the crack come from?" The logic of vial breakage at the stoppering station is the same: do not just fix the stoppering machine, but find the upstream step that gave the glass its crack in the first place.

blocks.zh: 兩種封塞方式
blocks.en: Two Stoppering Methods

blocks.zh: Pick-and-place（直接放置）：真空吸附塞子後直接放置，對準精度要求高，但封塞力可精確控制
blocks.en: Pick-and-place: the stopper is picked up by vacuum and placed directly; requires high alignment accuracy, but the insertion force can be controlled precisely

blocks.zh: Rotating wheel（旋轉輪）：塞子在旋轉盤上被依序推入瓶口，速度快，適合高產能產線
blocks.en: Rotating wheel: stoppers are pushed into the vial mouths in sequence on a rotating disc; fast, suitable for high-capacity lines

blocks.zh: 兩種方式均不涉及玻璃接觸，因此封塞站的重點管控是塞子的完整性與定位精度，而非玻璃損傷。
blocks.en: Neither method involves glass contact, so the key control at the stoppering station is stopper integrity and positioning accuracy, not glass damage.

blocks.zh: Section 5 (Part A) 章節總結 — 玻璃瓶處理製程（5.0–5.6）
blocks.en: Section 5 (Part A) Summary: Glass Vial Handling Process (5.0-5.6)

blocks.zh: 整體框架：玻璃瓶的損傷是一個累積過程，從供應商包材配置開始，每個轉移步驟都可能留下微損傷，後果在下游才顯現（尤其在凍乾或二次包裝）。
blocks.en: Overall framework: damage to glass vials is a cumulative process; starting from the supplier's pack-out configuration, every transfer step may leave micro-damage, and the consequences appear downstream (especially in lyophilization or secondary packaging).

blocks.zh: 包裝與運輸（5.1）：Pack-out configuration 必須標準化；禁止雙層棧板堆疊；shrink-wrap 模組需保持緊實，避免模組間碰撞造成玻璃對玻璃磨損。
blocks.en: Packaging and transport (5.1): the pack-out configuration must be standardized; double-stacking of pallets is prohibited; shrink-wrap modules must be kept tight to avoid glass-to-glass abrasion from collisions between modules.

blocks.zh: 整合產線（5.2）：最高風險點在 infeed screw → star wheel 的交接；旋轉積瓶台裝載量不超過 1/3；去熱原後的旋轉台是最易發生磨損的節點。
blocks.en: Integrated line (5.2): the highest-risk point is the infeed screw to star wheel handoff; rotary accumulator loading should not exceed 1/3; the rotary table after depyrogenation is the node most prone to abrasion.

blocks.zh: 洗瓶（5.3）：Needle strike 是首要風險，需定期檢查針頭直度；自動偵測倒置/雙層瓶可有效降低風險。
blocks.en: Washing (5.3): needle strike is the primary risk, and needle straightness must be checked periodically; automated detection of inverted/double-stacked vials can effectively reduce the risk.

blocks.zh: 去熱原（5.4）：325 °C 去除水膜後玻璃 COF 升高，磨損效應加劇；pull mode 輸送帶維持瓶間 ~1 mm 間距；批次烤箱出爐後在 Grade A 下操作並最小化晃動。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation (5.4): after the water film is removed at 325 °C, glass COF rises and the abrasion effect intensifies; a pull mode conveyor maintains ~1 mm spacing between vials; after batch oven unloading, operate under Grade A and minimize shaking.

blocks.zh: 充填（5.5）：充填針撞擊瓶口的損傷被封塞遮蓋，是最難被發現的損傷類型；建議以塑膠充填針替代不鏽鋼，以「針彎」代替「瓶碎」作為偵測機制。
blocks.en: Filling (5.5): damage from the filling needle striking the vial lip is masked by the stopper and is the type of damage hardest to detect; plastic filling needles are recommended in place of stainless steel, using "bent needle" instead of "broken vial" as the detection mechanism.

blocks.zh: 封塞（5.6）：封塞本身損傷風險最低；此站的破瓶幾乎必然是上游損傷的結果，應啟動溯源調查而非僅調整封塞機參數。
blocks.en: Stoppering (5.6): the stoppering step itself has the lowest risk of damage; a broken vial at this station is almost certainly the result of upstream damage, and a traceback investigation should be started rather than just adjusting the stoppering machine parameters.
